title: HTTP Client Environment Variables
description: Environment variables and authentication configuration for Kulala HTTP client files (http-client.env.json).

kulalaDefaultHeaders.description: Default HTTP headers applied to every request in this scope.

kulalaDefaultCurlOptions.description: Default curl flags applied to every request in this scope (Kulala extension).

items.description: A curl command-line flag, e.g. "--insecure" or "--max-time 5".

oneOf.description: Value sent with OAuth requests (all phases unless scoped).
Multiple values joined with a space.
Value with an explicit request scope.
Enable PKCE with the default SHA-256 challenge over an auto-generated verifier.
Custom PKCE settings for Authorization Code grant.

Code Challenge Method.description: PKCE code challenge method. JetBrains documents "Plain" and "SHA-256"; "S256" is accepted as an alias.

Code Verifier.description: PKCE code verifier. When omitted, a verifier is generated automatically.

alg.description: JWT signing algorithm. RS256 requires a private key; HS256 uses Client Secret.

oauth2Jwt.description: JWT settings for Client Credentials grant with "Client Credentials": "jwt".

Payload.description: JWT payload claims. exp and iat are optional and calculated automatically when omitted.

oauth2Config.description: OAuth 2.0 authentication configuration (JetBrains HTTP Client). Referenced via {{$auth.token("auth-id")}}.

Auth URL.description: Authorization server URL. Required for Authorization Code and Implicit grants.

Token URL.description: Token endpoint URL. Required for Authorization Code, Client Credentials, Device Authorization, and Password grants.

Redirect URL.description: OAuth redirect URI. Use http://localhost:PORT for local callback interception in Kulala.

Client ID.description: Public client identifier. Required for all grant types.

Client Secret.description: Confidential client secret. Required for Client Credentials grant. Prefer http-client.private.env.json.

Client Credentials.description: How client credentials are sent: none, in body, HTTP Basic (default). "jwt" is a Kulala extension.

Device Auth URL.description: Device authorization endpoint. Required for Device Authorization grant.

Open Complete URI.description: Device Authorization: open verification_uri_complete (with embedded user code) instead of verification_uri.

Start Polling After Browser.description: Device Authorization: poll the token endpoint only after the browser is closed.

Acquire Automatically.description: When true (default), acquire or refresh tokens automatically before sending requests.

Username.description: Resource owner username for the Password grant.

Password.description: Resource owner password for the Password grant. Prefer http-client.private.env.json.

Custom Headers.description: Additional HTTP headers for OAuth requests. Supports plain values or { Value, Use } objects.

Custom Request Parameters.description: Extra query or body parameters for OAuth requests (e.g. audience, resource).

Use ID Token.description: When true, {{$auth.token()}} returns the OpenID Connect id_token instead of the access token.

Response Type.description: Kulala extension: explicit OAuth response_type override.

Assertion.description: Kulala extension: pre-built JWT assertion for Client Credentials "jwt".

Expires In.description: Kulala extension: fallback token lifetime in seconds when the provider omits expires_in.

Browser CMD.description: Kulala extension: shell command to open the authorization URL.

mockConfig.description: Mock authentication for development and testing (JetBrains HTTP Client).

Token.description: Static access token returned by {{$auth.token("auth-id")}}. Prefer storing in http-client.private.env.json.

ID Token.description: Static OpenID Connect ID token returned by {{$auth.idToken("auth-id")}}. Prefer storing in http-client.private.env.json.

authConfig.description: Authentication configuration. Type must be "OAuth2" or "Mock".

securityAuth.description: Named authentication configurations for this environment.

^[\\w.-]+$.description: Authentication configuration ID referenced as {{$auth.token("auth-id")}} in .http files.

securityConfig.description: Security-related settings, including OAuth 2.0 and Mock authentication profiles.

customEnvVariable.description: Custom environment variable available as {{name}} in .http files.

environmentSection.description: Variables and settings for a single named environment (e.g. dev, staging, prod).

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor validation and autocompletion.

$kulalaShared.description: Kulala-only: variables and defaults shared across all environments in this file.
